title: 5.0L 32V Ti-VCT Emission-Control Reference
introduction: I start by keeping the engine identity attached to the explanation: this reference covers the 5.0L 32V Ti-VCT. It is the doorway to the emission-control chapter, with separate pointers for how the system works and what its components do. Those details are in the PC/ED manual; this page provides the destination rather than a diagnostic test or repair procedure.

edits.text: For system operation, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual, Section 1, Description and Operation.
edits.why: This referral leads to the explanation of how the emission-control system works. The referenced manual content is not included here.
